caption: The drawing depicts a single human figure standing within an arched niche structure outlined in black, gold, and red. The figure is wearing a long, patterned robe with olive green and brownish tones, and a golden crown adorned with red dots. The person has brown hair, a pale face with distinct black eyebrows, and is holding a black cross to their shoulder with both hands. To the right of the figure, there is a yellow pedestal with a red outline, supporting a white skull with black features. The figure stands on a red and white circular cushion or platform, which has a concentric red and gray pattern. The background inside the niche is white, and the overall composition is centered on a plain, off-white background.
title: Retablo-Santa Rita
